source: Presets transcribed from CODB01Classes.xlsx. Killstreaks were not in that file — the default profile is applied to all five and should be corrected per class if they differ.

presets.name: xJawz
presets.note: The only preset with Hardline, which makes it the only one where high streaks are realistic.

presets.name: Chabba
presets.note: Ghost plus suppressor plus Ninja is a complete stealth package — but the suppressor drops the FAMAS to a 3-shot kill inside 14m, so it only works if you fight close.

presets.name: Stealth
presets.note: The most internally coherent of the five. Hardened's reduced flinch pairs well with a suppressed mid-range gun, and Motion Sensor covers the flank you can't watch.

presets.name: Baz
presets.note: The unsuppressed FAMAS keeps its full 39.4m of 3-shot range. On the larger maps this is the strongest of your Famas classes.

presets.name: Nuketown
presets.note: Map-specific and correctly so. Flak Jacket and Tactical Mask are the two perks that matter most on Nuketown, and dual-wield Pythons are viable at the ranges that map produces.

scoring.note: Weighted toward perk synergy and map fit — the positioning-adjacent legs — rather than raw gun stats.

pairs.why: Off the minimap and silent. The complete concealment package and the basis of any flank.
Reduced flinch plus footstep information — you hear them first and you win the trade.
Pro shortens the window after sprinting where you can't shoot — the window a lot of deaths happen in.
The explosive and stun resistance package. Strong on small maps, wasted on large ones.
Subsidises sprinting into trouble. Actively works against the positioning problem.
Costs the Tier 3 slot that Ninja should own, and in TDM the enemy still banks the kill.
A sniper perk on a class that isn't sniping.

killstreakRealism.note: Scored on whether you will realistically collect the streaks you've picked. Total cost is compared against Hardline and against a TDM life expectancy of roughly 4–6 kills.
